title: New law: Water Quality Act of 1987 (Public Law 100-4)
summary: H.R. 1 of the 100th Congress became Public Law 100-4 on 1987-02-05.

title: New law: A joint resolution making emergency additional funds available by transfer for the fiscal year ending September 30, 1987, for the Emergency Food and Shelter Program of the Federal Emergency Management Agency. (Public Law 100-6)
summary: H.J.Res. 102 of the 100th Congress became Public Law 100-6 on 1987-02-12.

title: New law: A joint resolution congratulating Dennis Conner and the crew of STARS AND STRIPES for their achievement in winning the America's Cup. (Public Law 100-5)
summary: H.J.Res. 131 of the 100th Congress became Public Law 100-5 on 1987-02-11.
